# ✅ Release Checklist

- [ ] Source builds with strict warnings.
- [ ] Unit tests pass.
- [ ] Interactive smoke tests pass.
- [ ] Target OS and architecture recorded.
- [ ] Binary built from intended commit.
- [ ] Existing binary intentionally updated or left unchanged.
- [ ] MIT license and notice included.
- [ ] README and changelog updated.
- [ ] No local build products included.
- [ ] Limitations stated accurately.
